summary: Datavault AI Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a binding term sheet with Scilex Holding Company for a proposed cash contribution and revenue participation arrangement. Scilex will provide an upfront payment of $120M in multiple closings by December 31, 2026, to fund Datavault's quantum-ready GPU infrastructure across ~100 US cities. In return, Datavault will pay Scilex 30% of network revenues until $250M is paid, then 15% until $1.2B, then 5% for remaining GPU life. The arrangement is not a standard acquisition, tender, or restructuring; it is a unique financing-vs-revenue-sharing deal. Watch for definitive agreement execution and regulatory milestones.
